# Lab 16.12: Secure a Cloud SQL Instance

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL instance with private IP only, encrypted connections, IAM database login and deletion protection.

## Steps

1. **Set up private services access** for the `default` network.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable sqladmin.googleapis.com servicenetworking.googleapis.com
gcloud compute addresses create google-managed-services-default \
  --global --purpose=VPC_PEERING --prefix-length=16 --network=default
gcloud services vpc-peerings connect --service=servicenetworking.googleapis.com \
  --ranges=google-managed-services-default --network=default</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create the instance.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud sql instances create secure-pg \
  --database-version=POSTGRES_16 --edition=ENTERPRISE \
  --tier=db-f1-micro --region=us-central1 \
  --network=default --no-assign-ip \
  --ssl-mode=ENCRYPTED_ONLY \
  --database-flags=cloudsql.iam_authentication=on \
  --backup-start-time=03:00 \
  --deletion-protection</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Check what we got.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud sql instances describe secure-pg \
  --format="yaml(ipAddresses,settings.ipConfiguration.sslMode,settings.deletionProtectionEnabled)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   There is only a `PRIVATE` IP address.

4. **Add an IAM database user.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud sql users create alice@YOUR_DOMAIN --instance=secure-pg --type=cloud_iam_user
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=user:alice@YOUR_DOMAIN --role=roles/cloudsql.instanceUser
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=user:alice@YOUR_DOMAIN --role=roles/cloudsql.client</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Alice signs in with her Google identity. There is no database password to leak.

5. **Connect with the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy** from a VM in the `default` network:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">./cloud-sql-proxy --private-ip --auto-iam-authn YOUR_PROJECT_ID:us-central1:secure-pg &amp;
psql "host=127.0.0.1 user=alice@YOUR_DOMAIN dbname=postgres"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Enforce it with org policies.** Look at `sql.restrictPublicIp` and `sql.restrictAuthorizedNetworks` in **Organization policies**.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud sql instances patch secure-pg --no-deletion-protection
gcloud sql instances delete secure-pg --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Public IP | None |
| Connections | Encrypted only |
| Login | IAM identity, no password |
| Delete by mistake | Blocked by deletion protection |
